receipts.null_vs_json_text: retain SQL NULL separately from text such as null or {}
receipts.attempt_cardinality: one Action to zero or more actual provider receipts and execution observations; preserve each execution outcome/status/time independently; never store old attempt row or provider body wholesale
receipts.normalization_reason: Multiple candidate execution observations can share one verified canonical external result. Keep local outcomes and clocks on execution observation receipts; keep the provider result once on its canonical result receipt.

version_lineage.current_version: The canonical reference-only metadata receipt points directly to the current immutable provider-result body. Each candidate observation and Sent fact keeps its exact provider_receipt_id, so passive correction preserves the source-observable prior body.
version_lineage.canonical_binding: The canonical metadata receipt preserves the first source operation, target, agent_run_id, created_at and observed_at. Its provider_receipt_id may advance to the corrected body; current result_digest is projected from that referenced body.
version_lineage.source_correction: record_candidate_external_action accepts only the source ambiguous-to-sent transition with unchanged nested provider_result. The current observation advances to the corrected body. Other exact observation/Sent references stay on their original immutable body; only an unreferenced replaced verification wrapper may be retired.
version_lineage.prior_mismatch: If a prior reconciliation supplies a result different from the existing canonical body, preserve the canonical metadata and body and keep the supplied result local to that exact attempt.
version_lineage.independent_facts: A distinct provider send receipt and any body still referenced by an independent observation or Sent fact remain intact. No receipt is attached solely because it shares an Action.

coexistence.plan: Rebuild existing actions table declaration retaining all non-Action kinds, columns, indexes and triggers. Add exactly one common _kind=70 / record_type='action' layout. New Actions use action_data JSONB and generated virtual fields; no source/origin selector. Keep all existing kinds' facts and checks equivalent. legacy_key may be NULL only for Action; retain its existing namespace check for every other kind. Exclude Action from legacy namespace/public-key allocator and public-key index. Physical id and true external_action_key identify unified Actions.
coexistence.partial_release: Only the seven enumerated effect source families are converted in this first release. Other existing Actions kinds and specialized unsubscribe writers remain in the same physical table and are explicitly not retired.
coexistence.migration_inverse: Use explicit source-kind + original typed identity mapping only during conversion/inverse; never persist a legacy alias on Action rows.

inverse_metadata.ddl: source_type TEXT NOT NULL, source_identity TEXT NOT NULL, action_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES actions(id), receipt_id INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source_type, source_identity)
inverse_metadata.source_identity: Canonical typed encoding of the original physical/public identity, retaining source family and SQLite storage class; composite identities use a typed two-element encoding.
inverse_metadata.purpose: During explicit forward/inverse only, resolve every covered old identity and receipt identity to the current Action/receipt. Distinct source namespaces can share equal numeric or text values; direct Email public IDs are reconstructed from immutable plan ID plus operation, while email_historical_operations.action_ids_json stores physical Action IDs in current data.
inverse_metadata.runtime_access: No runtime caller reads or writes this table; Action queries use only current Action, receipt, and observer relations.
inverse_metadata.content_boundary: Identity and owner references only. No business payload, provider body, old schema SQL, or old database snapshot is stored here.
inverse_metadata.capacity: Expected row count is bounded by the seven covered source families and their receipt identities; storage cost is not yet measured on the authentic source copy.

target.common_payload: action_data SQLite JSONB object; every Action uses this same payload and typed generated virtual columns; only the discriminator selects Action versus unchanged existing record kinds.
target.payload_layout: one common JSONB object for common Action business facts; generated virtual columns provide SQL query/index access and avoid adding ~35 payload columns to each untouched row.

status_columns.action_status: One common nullable Action.status covers declared email lifecycle and reviewed candidate observation states; ordered raw observations remain in Action Receipt facts.
status_columns.receipt_status: Action Receipt.status retains each exact email attempt or candidate execution observation state, including NULL where source lacks status.

technical_references.name: prepared_receipt_id
technical_references.source_evidence: The old Store.prepare_outbound_postfix receipt writer references provider receipts by the prepared outbound key; Task 3 current writer and get_outbound_postfix_receipt require that same owner-local fact.
technical_references.purpose: Disambiguate the actual prepared-delivery provider receipt from canonical Action and Sent receipts after source entities converge on one Action.
technical_references.constraints: Nullable owner-local FK to action_receipts.id; the pointed receipt must be owned by this Action and contain a provider result. Runtime reads use this explicit Action pointer, never identity-map old namespaces.
technical_references.capacity: One nullable integer generated Action field and two owner triggers; no provider body or business data is duplicated.

action_status.semantic_rule: Use the last explicit source lifecycle observation in the frozen order; candidate verified means the source writer accepted an explicit verification receipt. No provider JSON/timestamp inference. Preserve every source observation unchanged.

receipt_status.semantic_rule: Keep each observation state exactly on its execution/attempt fact. Candidate verified is written only by the existing source writer after explicit verification receipt semantics; JSON/timestamps alone never establish verified/done. Historical prepared rows without a status remain NULL.
receipt_status.current_action_rule: The Action.status is the value of the last explicit candidate observation by updated_at, execution_id, action_index, id; an explicit later verified observation supersedes an earlier failed observation while both raw receipts and local outcomes remain. Historical result JSON may differ on reforward; each source observation remains independently reconstructible.
